core.headline: First-floor flat with lift and balcony in Chatham
core.listing:
A first-floor purpose-built flat in Chatham with lift access and a Juliet balcony. The accommodation comprises an open-plan kitchen/living room, two bedrooms and a bathroom, with one allocated parking space.

The open-plan kitchen/living room provides the main living space and opens onto a Juliet balcony. The flat has two bedrooms and a bathroom. A lift serves all floors.

The property comes with one allocated parking space.

Guide Price £195,000. Leasehold with 99 years remaining and a service charge of £1,450 per year (year ending March 2026). Council Tax Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C. The property has mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.
core.summary: A first-floor purpose-built flat with lift access, Juliet balcony and allocated parking in Chatham. The accommodation comprises an open-plan kitchen/living room, two bedrooms and a bathroom.
